She took a step back when he came close to her. It didn't stop him from cornering her, and her back hit the wall behind her. He raised his hand towards her face, and she closed her eyes, scared. She shuddered when his fingers trail down from her temple and her jaw and neck. Her blonde hair was left open.
“In the middle of the night?” she didn’t answer him knowing he could decipher her lies through her words.…
the-lord-of-the-high-reach:
In the world of Anathorn, Primal Beast run rampant, myriad races are scattered over the continents. Here the Gifted has the power to overturn the seas, uproot mountains and cleave the sky asunder.
Bramm Osric has been living in this world for more than 30 years, he has sailed the vast seas of the north and lived tales men could only dream of.
Yet when he retiresfrom the sea and settles in the mountains of the High Reach, only then did his tale really begin.
A transmigrated man, armed with a system capable of summoning the warriors of old. He and his house shall fight for a piece of the eternal history, fight for a place he could finally call his own.
Watch as a normal man, becomes a legend in a world full of power, might and continent destroying dangers.
This is the Rise of Osric, the legend of Anathorn!
the-ninth-throne:
Tai Hong died a failure.
A boxer who lost more fights than he won, buried in debt, and used to watching his opponents stand over him while the crowd celebrated his defeat.
But when he opened his eyes again, there was no boxing ring.
There was a battlefield.
Swords. Blood. Knights. A fortress.
And a boy named Alexander.
Reborn in a world ruled by the Church, where magic, Blessings, and ancient powers shape the fate of kingdoms, Alexander discovers that his new body possesses a power that should not exist.
His right hand commands.
His left hand destroys.
The first time he unleashes that power, he realizes something he never understood in his previous life:
He never truly hated losing.
He hated being weak.
This time, he refuses to be the man who falls and waits for someone else to help him back up.
He won't become a hero.
He won't seek justice.
If this world respects only the strong, then he will become stronger than all of them.
But power always comes with a price.
The Church fears what it cannot control. Kings hide secrets that could reshape the world. And behind the throne, someone else may be pulling the strings.…
the-system-mistook-me-for-a-cat:
Ten years after her parents’ divorce, the grandmother who raised Chu Tingwu passed away, leaving her to be shuttled back and forth between relatives.
At this moment, an entity claiming to be a “Cub Rearing System” suddenly appeared, wanting to bind itself to her and cultivate her into an outstanding graduate of its program.
Just as Chu Tingwu was about to refuse, she saw her personal attributes on the system interface—
[Name: Chu Tingwu]
[Species: Cat]
Chu Tingwu: Something’s not right here…
Due to a bug, the system had identified her as a kitten.
Her stats were those of a cat, but her appearance remained human.
How should an exemplary human-cat be raised? Sleeping, causing mischief, eating until she became as round as a pig?
However, the reality turned out to be quite different: extreme sports, expert bird-catcher, master mouse-hunter, catching invasive fish barehanded with dynamic vision, using camouflage and tracking skills to film documentaries of rare birds, nearly making the social news as a suspected retired special police officer.
For the first lesson in cultivation, the system said gravely:
“A cub cannot live alone.…

wayfarer-claim-the-unclaimable:
For thirteen years, Sio has failed at the one thing every Veyr should be able to do: make a Claim. Nothing has ever accepted him, so one night, mostly out of frustration, he looks up and tries to Claim the sky. He doesn't expect the sky to actually break open.
Something from the Passage tears its way into the living world and attacks him. Somehow, instead of losing his body to it, Sio wakes to find that he has finally made his first Claim, only to discover a Scar has appeared on his soul as well. A Veyr should never possess both.
Now an unknown entity shares his soul, his new Claim bends distance in ways he barely understands, and the creature he Claimed had been running from something far worse.
Sio spent most of his life believing nothing in this world would accept him. Maybe he was looking in the wrong world.
